fields.Name: T074 - Admin API Keys Section
fields.Description: Opens the Admin app Identity & Access → API Keys section once, then walks its sections (overview KPI drilldown, status filter tabs, column sort, revoke confirmation gate, creation wizard, Applications panel create, Scopes tree + create dialog, Usage time-range filter), verifying each via checkpoints. Consolidates old T176–T183.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box), switch to the Admin application, open 'Identity & Access', and select the 'API Keys' sub-section from the left navigation. Then walk these sections IN ORDER, and as you arrive at each set "checkpointReached" to the exact checkpoint name shown: (1) overview-drilldown — on the API Keys overview confirm a health-score banner and clickable KPI cards (Total Keys, Active, Expiring Soon, Revoked, Scope Categories); click a KPI card (e.g. 'Active') and confirm it drills into the list view with a 'Back to Overview' control and the matching filter applied; (2) status-filter-tabs — in the list view confirm filter tabs (All / Active / Expiring Soon / Expired / Never Used / Revoked) each with a count; click 'Active' then 'Revoked' and confirm the grid narrows to that category (or a valid empty-state) with the active tab highlighted; (3) column-sort — click a sortable column header (e.g. Owner or Created) and confirm a sort indicator appears and rows reorder, then click again to toggle the direction; (4) revoke-gate — click a key row to open the 'API Key Details' slide-out (Details / Permissions / Usage tabs); on an active key open the Danger Zone Revoke flow and confirm a 'type REVOKE to confirm' input with the confirm button disabled until REVOKE is entered exactly (do NOT actually revoke); (5) creation-wizard — click 'Generate New Key' to open the 'Generate New API Key' slide-out on step 1 (Configure) with a Key Label field and step indicator; type a label and click 'Next: Permissions' and confirm it advances to the scope-category step; (6) applications-create — click the 'Applications' L2 tab to open the API Applications panel (app cards with scope counts); click 'New Application' and confirm the slide-out renders Application Name, Description, and an Active checkbox, and that expanding an app card reveals a 'Scope Ceiling Rules' section; (7) scopes-tree — click the 'Scopes' L2 tab to see a hierarchical scope tree with expand/collapse controls; use 'Expand All' (or expand a node) and confirm the tree responds, then click 'New Scope' and confirm the create dialog renders Scope Name, a Parent Scope dropdown, Category, and a full-path preview (do NOT save); (8) usage-time-range — click the 'Usage' L2 tab to see the usage analytics (KPI grid + Request Volume chart + time-range buttons 24 Hours / 7 Days / 30 Days / All Time); select a different range (e.g. '7 Days' then 'All Time') and confirm that button highlights and the analytics update or a valid 'No usage data' empty-state shows. If any control is legitimately absent due to permissions or empty data, note it and continue. Keep going until every section has been visited. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait for content rather than navigating away.

checkpoints.name: overview-drilldown
checkpoints.instruction: KPI card drills into filtered list
visualCriteria: The API Keys overview renders a health-score banner and clickable KPI cards with counts, and clicking a KPI card transitions to the list view (a 'Back to Overview' control is visible) with the matching filter applied

checkpoints.name: status-filter-tabs
checkpoints.instruction: status filter tabs narrow the grid
visualCriteria: The API key list renders filter tabs (All / Active / Expiring Soon / Expired / Never Used / Revoked) each with a count; selecting a different tab narrows the visible rows to that category or shows a valid empty-state, and the active tab is highlighted

checkpoints.name: column-sort
visualCriteria: Clicking a sortable column header (e.g. Owner or Created) shows a sort-direction indicator and reorders the rows, and clicking the same header again toggles the direction, OR a valid empty-state is shown when no keys exist

checkpoints.name: revoke-gate
visualCriteria: Clicking a key row opens the 'API Key Details' slide-out with Details / Permissions / Usage tabs, and for an active key the Revoke flow shows a 'type REVOKE to confirm' input with the confirm button disabled until REVOKE is entered exactly, OR a valid empty-state is shown when no keys exist

checkpoints.name: creation-wizard
visualCriteria: The 'Generate New API Key' slide-out opens on step 1 (Configure) with a Key Label field and a step indicator, and after typing a label and clicking 'Next: Permissions' the wizard advances to the scope-selection step

checkpoints.name: applications-create
visualCriteria: The 'Applications' tab shows the API Applications panel (app cards with scope counts or a valid empty-state), clicking 'New Application' opens a slide-out with Application Name, Description and an Active checkbox, and expanding an app card reveals a 'Scope Ceiling Rules' section

checkpoints.name: scopes-tree
checkpoints.instruction: scope tree expand + New Scope dialog
visualCriteria: The 'Scopes' tab shows a hierarchical scope tree with expand/collapse controls that respond to Expand All / a node toggle, and clicking 'New Scope' opens a dialog with Scope Name, a Parent Scope dropdown, and Category fields

checkpoints.name: usage-time-range
visualCriteria: The 'Usage' tab renders usage analytics with a KPI grid and time-range buttons (24 Hours / 7 Days / 30 Days / All Time), and selecting a different range highlights that button as active and the analytics/chart update or a valid 'No usage data' empty-state is shown
